correctness.rationale: Algebraic composition denominators are positive and exactly given in RESULT.md. Differentiation of their difference yields the strict sign using the monotonicity of (1+tK)/(1+tx) for fixed x. At p=1 the commutator vanishes identically. For p<1 each map increases globally; for p>1 with a(p-1)K<=1 each increases on the invariant interval [0,K]. Adjacent swaps thus prove all permutation inequalities, and an overcompensatory strongest season with H_c′(K)<0 reverses the earlier strict comparison. Exact rational witness computed with standalone standard-library code; 11,444 sampled checks supplement but do not prove universal claims.

value.rationale: A motivated finite-season ecological scheduling question obtains a complete contest/Beverton-Holt/scramble exchange trichotomy and global sorting when propagation is monotone. The sharp boundary c(p-1)K=1 and minimal 3-season obstruction show how overcompensation destroys rearrangement optimality, an effect not captured by a two-map calculation. An exact rational reversal illustrates an operationally significant distinction; no claims of empirical validity, infinite-horizon optimization, or publication-scale contribution are required.
